verdicts.reason: A: the headline wraps to two lines and nearly fills the circle, while the italic tagline is squeezed into a 4-line narrow column. The RSVP pill is tiny and the legal text is microscopic. A huge grey placeholder box dominates the right side, and the phone is wedged in. The reading order is jumbled and the layout is cramped and scattered. B: it keeps a clear left-to-right flow from logo and headline to the date, pills, a large RSVP button and the phone. The tagline sits on one line below the headline. Flaws: the headline is close to the circle edge and the left margin, the placeholder image is small and crammed against the phone at the right edge, the legal text is tiny, and the middle column is a bit tight. It is still much cleaner than A.
